summary: Someone who favors an integrated housing proposal speaks after hearing neighbors argue against it.
realLife: Individuals and representatives of community groups spoke for Lincoln Green during crowded meetings where many attendees openly opposed it. Speakers on both sides discussed who would live there.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with speaker, proposal, meeting. A community member can explain at home why they wanted support for the project on the record.

turns.what: A supporter gives the clerk a letter when their work shift keeps them from speaking.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk accepts written submissions before the hearing closes.
turns.writesBack: The letter enters the record under the sender's name.
